A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LEC research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, algorithms, and Appendices A–D are readable and can be matched despite the revised title and layout.

before.justification: v2 reports original selective-prediction and routing experiments on CommonsenseQA, TriviaQA, ScienceQA, and MM-Vet v2 in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including risk, power, routing allocation, and sensitivity results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: The empirical constraints, threshold objectives, and acceptance/routing procedures in Equations (5)–(11) remain unchanged. Algorithms 2–3 explicitly expand the existing constraint checks; the optional search guidance does not establish adoption of a different procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four QA/VQA datasets, open-ended and closed-ended tasks, white-box and black-box uncertainty settings, and single-model and two-model scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged. Algorithm 1 corrects the documented UCB-CLP calculation by setting its upper bound to 1 when every accepted calibration prediction is erroneous, rather than applying the inverse-beta formula with a zero shape parameter. No rerun is established.

E3.justification: Dataset sizes, preprocessing, models, calibration/test splits, generation settings, and correctness criteria remain unchanged. Section 4.1 explicitly explains the existing accepted-error proportion; it does not establish a changed metric calculation. The newly stated baseline significance level is additional disclosure.

E4.justification: The joint-versus-independent routing comparison and analyses of uncertainty estimators, correctness criteria, answer sampling, calibration/test ratios, and uncertainty-correctness distributions are retained. Appendix D adds no new analytical experiment.

E5.justification: Appendix C first specifies the UCB confidence-bound significance level as delta = 0.05 and explicitly handles the Clopper–Pearson all-errors boundary. The 500 random splits and mean/standard-deviation reporting remain unchanged; additional runs are not reported.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and the experimental plots in Figures 2–21 match. For example, TriviaQA power for Qwen2.5-14B at alpha = 0.05 remains 0.7193 for LEC and 0.6240 for UCB-CLP. The reported experimental findings are retained.

T1.justification: Appendix A removes the initial conditioning on learned thresholds and inserts expectations around calibration/test averages in the proof arguments. Theorems 3.1–3.2 explicitly address zero-probability selection. These are limited formal corrections; the central constraints and claimed marginal guarantees remain the same.

C1.justification: The title, abstract, and introduction qualify the advertised FDR guarantee as selection-conditioned marginal error control, explicitly describing a ratio of expectations. This clarifies the scope of a conditional-probability target already present in v2; the retention-maximization and routing contributions remain.

C2.justification: Section 4.1 newly distinguishes population selection-conditioned error from the observed accepted-error proportion, explaining the retained FDR axes as empirical plotting shorthand and a plug-in estimate. v3 also explicitly calls the guarantee vacuous when acceptance has probability zero.

D1.justification: Figure 1 adds a code-repository link. Appendix C supplies the previously unstated baseline significance level, more explicit calibration pseudocode, and optional offline search and threshold-granularity guidance. These improve documentation without establishing changed experimental implementations.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to BalanceRAG, feasibility-aware set-valued prediction, and conformal lesion segmentation. The overall positioning remains similar. COIN's replacement of its preprint entry with an AAAI 2026 entry refers to the same work.

P1.justification: The risk narrative is systematically revised across the abstract, introduction, methodology, and appendices, with substantial restructuring of proof exposition and a greatly shortened Impact Statement. v3 also adds conflict-of-interest and acknowledgment text and revises the title, affiliations, and publication header.

P2.justification: Figure 1's guarantee text and numerous captions are revised to explain selection-conditioned risk, while experimental graphics and table structures are retained. Some displays relocate, including Figure 8 beneath Table 2 and several appendix figures; there is no major visual redesign.

improvement.justification: Compared with v2, v3 identifies the risk target more precisely and improves reproducibility through a code link and explicit calibration details. These are useful, limited gains. The revised Appendix A still does not establish the symmetry asserted for calibration-selected thresholds in Equations (17) and (22), so the central proof gap is not resolved.
